surfaces.name: Zuse Electron desktop app (macOS, Linux x64; Windows x64 test candidate)
zuse CLI and Zuse Serve headless host (@zusehq/serve)

claims.answer: Electron desktop app for macOS (signed universal) and x64 Linux (deb, AppImage); Windows x64 is a CI test candidate only. Hosted web app and local-browser access, native iPhone app, zuse CLI. No Android or editor extension.

evidence.title: Zuse README
evidence.locator: Intro; Install; Supported agents; What is shipped; Tech stack; License
evidence.finding: Chat-first Electron desktop app wrapping Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode and Pi with worktrees, review, terminal, cloud workspaces; macOS and x64 Linux, Windows x64 test candidate; AGPL-3.0-only.

evidence.title: Zuse changelog
evidence.finding: v0.25.1 notes say this version of Zuse will be discontinued soon and to install the new Zuse from opcodehq/zuse to keep receiving updates.

evidence.title: Install and connect Zuse
evidence.locator: Install the app; Add Zuse to Slack; Connect a provider; Add a project
evidence.finding: macOS signed universal app, Debian/Ubuntu deb and AppImage; Slack app; onboarding; provider status; existing folder, clone or quick start projects; git repositories get worktrees.

evidence.title: Providers
evidence.finding: Built-in providers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor SDK, Grok, Kiro, OpenCode, Pi plus any ACP agent such as Gemini CLI; Zuse does not bundle a paid provider subscription.

evidence.title: Install, sign in, and update providers
evidence.finding: Native CLI logins or API keys in an encrypted vault; Claude Code and Codex support multiple accounts with switch on usage limit; custom model IDs.

evidence.title: Remote access
evidence.finding: Zuse Serve (account, anywhere), Tailscale and local network let a browser, iPhone or another desktop control an environment; the environment keeps execution.

evidence.title: Remote access security
evidence.finding: Connections off by default, single-use five-minute pairing links, per-device revocable credentials; provider credentials stay on the environment.

evidence.title: Hosted remote access
evidence.locator: Link the desktop app; Open from browser and iPhone
evidence.finding: Zuse Serve registers the computer over an encrypted outbound connection; hosted web app and iPhone select an online computer; offline computers remain listed.

evidence.title: Agent orchestration
evidence.locator: Choose the right boundary; Provider and model choice; Permissions
evidence.finding: An agent can create separate tasks (worktree and branch), session tabs and subagents, pick another provider/model and send attributed follow-ups; Plan mode blocks creation.

evidence.title: Run agents in parallel
evidence.finding: Parallel work uses separate worktrees; session tabs share a checkout; one integrator owns the result.

evidence.title: Subagents and delegated tasks
evidence.locator: In-conversation subagents; Native workflow boards; Delegated tasks
evidence.finding: Provider subagents are displayed; delegated tasks appear as sidebar chats with Open chat.

evidence.title: Monitor delegated work
evidence.finding: Parent can read recent progress and send attributed follow-ups; failed delegated checkouts keep files and can be resumed or replaced.

evidence.title: Modes and permissions
evidence.finding: Plan mode is read-only; Ask for approval, Approve for me and Full access runtime modes; Full access is not a sandbox; Cursor uses SDK sandbox; Pi has no plan or permission modes.

evidence.title: Skills and MCP
evidence.finding: Claude Code and Codex skills discovered from native directories; agents get MCP tools only via Zuse session gateway from plugins connected in Plugins; provider-file MCP servers not passed through.

evidence.title: Context and attachments
evidence.finding: New chat can start from a GitHub issue, pull request or branch; files, images and PDFs attach.

evidence.title: Worktrees
evidence.locator: What is isolated; What uses disk space; Creation lifecycle
evidence.finding: Per-chat git worktree under ~/.zuse, scoped files/terminal/git/PR, node_modules linked when lockfile identical, setup and run scripts, archive checkpoints.

evidence.title: Repository scripts
evidence.finding: Committed setup, run and archive scripts, auto_run_after_setup, environment variables.

evidence.title: Zuse for iPhone
evidence.locator: What you can do; What runs where
evidence.finding: Native iPhone client for Mac or Serve computers: inbox, composer, approvals, files, change review; no execution on the phone.

evidence.title: Mobile review
evidence.locator: Review changes; Commit, push, and merge; Restore a checkpoint
evidence.finding: Phone can review scopes, commit, push, mark ready, merge PR (squash), auto-merge, revert, stash and restore checkpoints.

evidence.title: Offline and notifications
evidence.finding: Cached history, queued offline messages, push notifications for signed-in accounts.

evidence.title: Zuse Serve
evidence.finding: npx @zusehq/serve turns a Mac or Linux computer (systemd user service) into an account-linked environment; it does not provision machines or install CLIs.

evidence.title: Agent CLI
evidence.finding: zuse CLI with JSON output creates and inspects chats and sessions, sends messages, changes modes, interrupts, creates cloud workspaces; plugins and orchestration commands.

evidence.title: Zuse API
evidence.finding: Cloud API with bearer zk_ keys: workspaces, messages, attachments, projects, providers, signed webhooks; requires a Cloud subscription or connected cloud provider account.

evidence.title: Share a cloud chat
evidence.finding: Organization cloud chats can be shared with View or Edit permission per member; preview links are public.

evidence.title: Start a task from Slack
evidence.finding: Mention @Zuse to start a cloud chat; account connection and per-workspace access modes.

evidence.title: Settings reference
evidence.finding: Settings sections; organization workspace has Members and a billing role.

evidence.title: Recover or continue a local task
evidence.finding: Queued follow-ups are stored with the session; after a failed turn the queue is held until Resume.

evidence.title: Zuse pricing page source
evidence.finding: Local $0 during beta (open-source desktop app, bring your own agents); Cloud Workspace $40/month USD with $35 provider compute included, extra at provider cost + 5%, $25 default overage cap.

evidence.title: Zuse privacy policy source
evidence.locator: Product and reliability analytics; Local work stays local
evidence.finding: Desktop analytics are enabled by default and mobile is off until enabled; Share usage analytics setting; local project data is not uploaded to a Zuse backend to run the local workspace; PostHog on website.

evidence.title: Zuse subprocessors source
evidence.finding: WorkOS authentication, PostHog analytics, Cloudflare, E2B Cloud Workspace compute, Stripe, Polar, Expo push, GitHub App.

evidence.title: Zuse security page source
evidence.locator: Security starts with the environment; Credentials
evidence.finding: Environment boundaries, encrypted local credential vault keyed by OS credential store, pairing with safety phrase; agent permissions are a deliberate control.

evidence.title: Cloud billing operations
evidence.finding: Cloud Workspace $40 monthly includes $35 provider usage, 5% markup beyond, $25 default overage cap; billing enforcement is rollout-controlled.

evidence.title: Cloud lifecycle
evidence.finding: Cloud workspaces have durable states (queued, ready, paused, archived, failed) reconciled by a leased reconciler; paused workspaces retain storage; prompts can be submitted while preparing.

evidence.title: Scheduled task contract
evidence.finding: Scheduled tasks with once, interval (min 60 seconds) and webhook schedules, exposed to agents as schedule_task and related tools in packages/agents/src/drivers/automation-tools.ts.

evidence.title: GNU Affero General Public License v3 (LICENSE)
evidence.finding: Repository LICENSE is the AGPL-3.0 text; README states AGPL-3.0-only for the source code except third-party areas.

evidence.title: GitHub API for swarajbachu/zuse
evidence.finding: Repository has 250 stars, license AGPL-3.0, not archived, last push 2026-11-16, description open source devin (cloud agents).

evidence.title: Zuse releases
evidence.finding: v0.25.1 (2026-11-15) ships macOS dmg and universal zip, Linux deb and AppImage with updater manifests; no Windows asset; Windows is a CI test candidate.

evidence.title: GitHub API for opcodehq/zuse (successor)
evidence.finding: Successor repository opcodehq/zuse is public, AGPL-3.0, 40 stars, with v0.26.1 released 2026-11-15; contents were not inspected.

evidence.title: Bounded search: native issue tracker
evidence.locator: rg -i "issue tracker|kanban|backlog|epic|ticket" apps/server/src apps/renderer/src packages/domain; docs: linear|jira|github issue
evidence.finding: No product-owned issue tracker or backlog; GitHub issues are only an attachment source for Create from, and Linear is reachable through plugins.

evidence.title: Bounded search: SSO and provisioning
evidence.finding: No SSO or SCIM implementation; sign-in is WorkOS public-client authorization. Matches were unrelated provider availability code.

evidence.title: Bounded search: living specs and indexing
evidence.locator: ls specs; rg -i "code index|living spec" specs README.md
evidence.finding: specs/ holds engineering design specs; README says the 0.04 code index is spec complete and not yet built; no maintained product-spec feature.

evidence.title: Bounded search: Android client
evidence.locator: ls apps/mobile apps/ios; rg -i "android|testflight|app store" apps/docs/content/docs/mobile README.md
evidence.finding: No Android directory or documented Android client; docs describe only Zuse for iPhone; apps/mobile has an Expo config with an android key but no android project.

evidence.title: Bounded search: per-task cost display
evidence.finding: Server has provider usage limit readers (e.g. grok-usage, rate-limit bubbles) but docs describe no per-task or per-session cost view; cloud billing exposes compute usage totals.

changes.summary: Initial full-profile source pass over v0.25.1: README, in-repo docs, privacy/security/pricing page sources, cloud docs and bounded code searches; noted the changelog discontinuation notice pointing to opcodehq/zuse.

locations.result: v0.25.1 (2026-11-15) is the newest release of this repository.
Changelog states this version will be discontinued soon and points to opcodehq/zuse for updates; no feature dates.
Successor repository live with v0.26.1 (2026-11-15); not inspected in this pass.
Public issues; no dated product announcements recorded.

gaps: Several atomic answers are unknown because the pass did not complete code inspection of those behaviors (for example scheduled-task overlap and retries, network policy, rebase, export); they are not closed components and should be resolved from the pinned source in a follow-up pass. The successor repository opcodehq/zuse has newer releases whose differences were not compared; a later pass should re-pin there. Windows status and cloud beta availability are time-sensitive.
